Class.summary: Global exception handler implementing to transform uncaught application exceptions into RFC 7807 compliant ProblemDetails responses.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The service responsible for serializing RFC 7807 problem details to the HTTP response.
The logger used for recording diagnostic messages and application errors.

TryHandleAsync.summary: Attempts to handle an unhandled exception by mapping it to an appropriate HTTP status code and writing an RFC 7807 ProblemDetails payload.
TryHandleAsync.param: The unhandled exception thrown by an endpoint or pipeline behavior.
TryHandleAsync.returns: A indicating whether the exception was handled successfully.
